cells.gaps: No source says what share of taxpayers hold a Ghana Card PIN as their tax number.
cells.note: GRA issues TINs from a computerised system in service (GHA-001) and at business registration through its TIN Centre at the Registrar-General's Department (GHA-002). In September 2025 the NIA's Executive Secretary said the Ghana Card serves as the Taxpayer Identification Number (GHA-004), so stage 5.
